# ✅ AdSense Script Implementation - FIXED

## Issue Identified and Resolved

**Problem:** Custom attribute `data-finvexo-adsense` was added to the AdSense script tag, which is not a standard Google AdSense attribute.

**Fix Applied:** Removed the custom attribute. The script now uses **only standard Google-approved attributes**.

---

## Current Implementation (Correct)

### Script Tag (Generated by Code)

```html
<script
  async
  src="https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-6947636494282386"
  crossorigin="anonymous">
</script>
```

### Attributes Used

| Attribute | Value | Purpose | Required by Google? |
|-----------|-------|---------|-------------------|
| `async` | true | Load script asynchronously | ✅ Yes |
| `src` | AdSense URL | Script source | ✅ Yes |
| `crossorigin` | "anonymous" | CORS policy | ✅ Yes |

**No custom attributes!** ✅

---

## What Was Removed

### Old Implementation (Incorrect)

```javascript
// OLD CODE (Had custom attribute)
script.dataset.finvexoAdsense = "true"; // ❌ Not standard
document.querySelector("script[data-finvexo-adsense]") // ❌ Custom selector
```

### New Implementation (Correct)

```javascript
// NEW CODE (Standard Google implementation)
const script = document.createElement("script");
script.async = true;
script.src = `https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=${adsensePublisherId}`;
script.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
// No custom attributes! ✅

// Check for existing script using standard method
document.querySelector(`script[src*="pagead2.googlesyndication.com"]`)
```

---

## How to Verify the Fix

### Step 1: Rebuild Your Project

```bash
npm run build
```

### Step 2: Inspect the Generated HTML

1. Start dev server: `npm run dev`
2. Open browser (http://localhost:5173)
3. Press F12 → Elements tab
4. Look in `<head>` for the AdSense script

### Step 3: Verify Script Tag

You should see:

```html
<script
  async=""
  src="https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-6947636494282386"
  crossorigin="anonymous">
</script>
```

**No** `data-finvexo-adsense` attribute! ✅

---

## Ad Unit Implementation (Also Correct)

The ad units use standard Google AdSense format:

```html
<ins class="adsbygoogle"
     style="display:block;width:100%"
     data-ad-client="ca-pub-6947636494282386"
     data-ad-slot="1234567890"
     data-ad-format="auto"
     data-full-width-responsive="true">
</ins>
```

All attributes are standard Google AdSense attributes. ✅

## Why This Fix Matters

### Before (With Custom Attribute)

**Potential issues:**
- Google might reject non-standard attributes
- Script validation could fail
- Unclear if it caused ad serving issues

### After (Standard Implementation)

**Benefits:**
- ✅ Follows Google's exact specifications
- ✅ No non-standard attributes
- ✅ Better compatibility
- ✅ Cleaner code

---

## Complete Current Implementation

### AdSenseLoader Component

```javascript
export function AdSenseLoader() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const adsbygoogleSrc = `https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=${adsensePublisherId}`;

    // Standard Google implementation
    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.async = true;
    script.src = adsbygoogleSrc;
    script.crossOrigin = "anonymous";

    document.head.appendChild(script);
  }, []);
  return null;
}
```

### AdSenseUnit Component

```javascript
export function AdSenseUnit({ slot }) {
  return (
    <ins
      className="adsbygoogle"
      style={{ display: "block", width: "100%" }}
      data-ad-client={adsensePublisherId}
      data-ad-slot={slot}
      data-ad-format="auto"
      data-full-width-responsive="true"
    />
  );
}
```

Both components now use **only Google-standard attributes**. ✅
